title: GTA 6 Shatters Spotify Streaming Record with Official Soundtrack
description: GTA 6 continues its record-breaking streak as its official soundtrack, featuring Dua Lipa, sets a new Spotify opening day streaming record with 29.85 million streams.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Keeps Breaking Records: Official Soundtrack Dominates Spotify

It seems that *GTA 6* simply cannot stop breaking records. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster has added yet another milestone to its historic run, this time dominating the music streaming charts.

### A New Milestone in Music Streaming

Already cemented as the biggest entertainment launch in history and the highest-rated game of all time, *GTA 6* is continuing to push boundaries beyond traditional gaming metrics. The game's official album has officially set a brand-new opening day record for a soundtrack on Spotify, pulling in a staggering **29.85 million streams** on its first day.

### Star-Studded Lineup Drives Engagement

Industry context shows that the Grand Theft Auto franchise has always prided itself on legendary in-game radio stations and culturally curated soundtracks. This record-breaking official album features all-new tracks from major global artists, including the likes of Dua Lipa. The powerful combination of top-tier pop star power and the unmatched hype surrounding *GTA 6* undoubtedly fueled this unprecedented streaming success on Spotify.

## Editor's Take

*GTA 6* is proving that its cultural impact extends far beyond standard gaming circles. Pulling in nearly 30 million streams on day one for a soundtrack is an extraordinary feat. It highlights how Rockstar Games manages to blend gaming with mainstream pop culture seamlessly, turning everything associated with the franchise into an instant cultural phenomenon.
